Name: Lance's Hair
Author: LeshtheWanderer
Description:
I love [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13232]Qingsha's[/url] portrait of Lance but preferred that he be in the same style as everyone else. So I took his portraits and sprites from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] and redrew his hair and edited a few other small things like adding the earring. I also used [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13865]Rei's[/url] sprites for reference when editing those.

I really just did this for me but I figured someone else might like it too, so here you go! Enjoy! :3


[b][u]To use
[/u][/b]unzip/extract and drop [i]both[/i] folders in with your mods

if you don't want the seasonal outfits just use the second folder

Downloads.Description: Thanks to a comment I realized I was missing the sprites in the Stardew Valley Expanded folder.
